diagram_math_checks.evidence: The exceptional supplier defines E as the inverse image of the center, with no shape or regularity assumption. Step 4.1 computes Y′ cap E = Spec(A/m) = Spec kappa(p). Thus q is reduced, maps isomorphically to Spec kappa(p), has kappa(q)=kappa(p), and has exceptional intersection length one. Other points of E are not counted or excluded.

Step 1.1 sets N to the DVR quotient length. Step 4.2 uses J′=(JB):x_1^infinity and K=psi(J′), containing fbar/xbar_1 of valuation N-1. Conditional on q in Z′, K=(xbar_1^j) is proper and nonzero, so 1 <= j <= N-1. Quotient module length over the surjective ambient local-ring quotient equals DVR module length; no degree or geometric-point factor is inserted.

Step 2.1 says q is the only point of Y′ above p. Therefore q not in Z′ means Y′ and Z′ are disjoint over p, without asserting global disjointness. When N=1 the conditional left branch is impossible, exactly as step 5.1 proves. The diagonal arrows in the lower panel indicate logical cases, not scheme morphisms.

No regular or smooth ambient surface, transversal intersection, P1 exceptional fiber, integrality of Z, exact decrement, or intersection point-count interpretation is supplied.
